answer: Vouch trellis: a new agent earns rewards only after two established agents each lock a bond for it, and each voucher may back at most three newcomers per epoch. Every epoch the network spot-audits work and scores the delta between what a newcomer claimed and what it really did; a bad delta slashes the newcomer and both vouchers. A sybil farm thus needs a growing trellis of real, bonded sponsors, and one exposed clone rusts its whole branch like ferrous metal left in rain.
